spec_match.rationale: Uses Iterator.zip over generators with finally-block close tracking for break, exhaustion and consumer throw.

interactive.rationale: Mode/stop/how selects plus "Walk them" update per-feed pulled/exhausted/closed state and the step table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The cleanup/laziness angle the index promises.

edge_cases.rationale: Early break, normal end and consumer throw are all selectable.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 8/8 PASS including default-shortest and unknown-mode TypeError, i.e. negative contracts, not just existence.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): early-break walk closed all three generators after 4 steps; console/network clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Re-run the walk when a select changes, or say that it does not
openQuestions.detail: Changing Mode alone leaves the previous result on screen until "Walk them" is pressed, so the readout briefly describes a mode that is not selected. Either re-run on change or mark the result stale.

summary: Critique-only pass. Loaded http://localhost:3109/v153/joint-iteration/merge-and-close/ in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass), clicked/changed every visible control, captured console errors and failed requests, checked 360px horizontal overflow and a Tab focus walk, and ran /v153/joint-iteration/conformance/ (unflagged, and with the relevant --enable-blink-features flag where one exists). Only minor follow-ups remain.
